---
title: Replicate This Study
description: Everything you need to run this evaluation yourself — with your own models, annotators, or question bank extensions.
---

All materials needed to replicate this evaluation are published openly. This page describes what you need, what you can reuse as-is, and where adaptation may be required.

## What You Need

1. **API access** to the models you want to evaluate. See [Data Collection](../data-collection/index.qmd) for setup.
2. **Python 3.10+** and the packages listed in [Environment Setup](../data-collection/setup.qmd).
3. **Domain-expert annotators** — at minimum two with graduate-level knowledge of early Christianity. See [Annotation Protocol](../methodology/index.qmd#annotation-protocol) for annotator requirements and training materials.
4. **The rubric** — download from [Evaluation Rubric](../methodology/rubric.qmd).
5. **The question bank** — download from [Figures & Question Bank](../figures/index.qmd).

## What You Can Reuse Without Modification

- The full question bank (11 general questions per figure plus 6–7 figure-specific ones, [CSV](../figures/question_bank.csv))
- The rubric definitions and scoring sheet template ([Evaluation Rubric](../methodology/rubric.qmd))
- All data collection notebooks ([Data Collection](../data-collection/index.qmd))
- The annotation protocol ([Annotation Protocol](../methodology/index.qmd#annotation-protocol))
- The reference profiles and fact-check sheets for each figure, published in condensed form on the figure pages ([Macrina](../figures/macrina.qmd), [Olympias](../figures/olympias.qmd))

## What May Require Adaptation

- **New models**: add a new notebook following the pattern of the existing API tutorials. The shared system prompt and data format should be used unchanged for comparability.
- **New figures**: add a new page to the Figures section following the template of [Macrina the Younger](../figures/macrina.qmd). Add three questions (Basic / Intermediate / Advanced) to the question bank CSV.
- **Different annotators**: re-run the pilot round with your annotators to establish local calibration. Report your inter-annotator alpha alongside any results.
